_comment: EXPECTED TO DIFFER PER SITE. The budgets tests/page-weight.spec.ts checks (decoded kilobytes).
Set 2026-10-27 from the CI-shaped build (no Sanity project, so no photographs) plus about 25%:
HTML 31 to 45 KB, inline CSS under 1 KB, scripts 320 KB, preloaded fonts none.
Images keep the spec's own numbers because a build with content adds the course and faculty photos.
A route that must be heavy gets its own entry under pages, with the reason in _why.

/contact/._why: The contact form island loads React, the form libraries and Turnstile (2104 KB decoded when measured, 2026-10-27).

/style-guide/sections/._why: The internal wall of example sections, one of every builder-kit block (104 KB of HTML), with the kit's styles written inline once (23 KB) because no live page links them (2026-10-27).

/style-guide/._why: The style guide draws every token and component on one page (71 KB of HTML when measured, 2026-10-27).
